title: Svengali Icon Collection
description: A collection of SVG paths used as icons in Svengali layouts.

propertyNames.description: Icon names must be namespaced using a dot (e.g., 'namespace.name') and use lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

width.description: The intrinsic width of the SVG coordinate system for this icon.

height.description: The intrinsic height of the SVG coordinate system for this icon.

path.description: Must be valid SVG path data starting with 'M' or 'm'.
